brief.zh: find_peak_index(readings) 要返回最高读数第一次出现的下标，编号从 0 开始。空列表返回 -1。看看最后一项和同分的情况。
brief.en: find_peak_index(readings) should return the zero-based index of the first maximum, or -1 for an empty list. Check the last item and cases with ties.

concept.zh: 用不同用例分别定位漏读末项和同分选择错误
concept.en: Use separate cases to find a skipped last item and incorrect tie handling

hints.zh: range 的结束值不会走到。用 len(readings) 作结束值才能读到最后一项。
hints.en: range excludes its stop value. Stopping at len(readings) lets the loop see the last item.

hints.zh: 只有遇到严格更大的读数才更新位置。相等时保留先出现的下标。
hints.en: Replace the saved index only when a value is strictly greater. On a tie, keep the earlier index.

label.en: Update only for a strictly higher value
